items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to a hip injury.
items.why: Hip injury; McVay notes not making great progress, cautious approach, not long-term.
items.implication: Likely OUT or GTD Week 3 vs DEN; boosts Adams targets/routes.
items.opportunity: High route/target share for Davante Adams without Nacua.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Trending OUT Week 3 at IND; elevates Schultz/Hutchinson.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike for Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after expected knee surgery ending his 2026 season (ACL intact).
items.why: Knee (MCL/PCL/meniscus); surgery for full recovery but season over.
items.implication: Giants QB carousel; impacts all pass-catchers volume/quality.
items.opportunity: Potential Winston or free agent start; Nabers/others remain key but lower ceiling.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (stinger) on practice field after good MRI; expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.why: Good MRI; suited up at practice.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks to IR (core muscle surgery, 6+ weeks); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead back (RB14 util), Dillon primary backup.
Loves Christian Watson vs ATL: WR8 utilization, 38% RZ tgts; WR9 PPG since Wk11 last yr. Reed OUT.
TNF questions: Has Marshawn Lloyd ceded GB backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Can healthy Penix revive Drake London/Kyle Pitts? Reed absence more 2TE/Watson? Packers OL hold for Watson/Golden?
items.why: Usage/role uncertainty into ATL@GB; Penix full participant.
items.implication: Monitor Lloyd/Johnson split, London/Pitts bounce-back, Watson upside.
items.opportunity: Penix health expands ATL pass game; Reed OUT boosts Watson/2TE.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua, targeted on 42%; exploded for 8-195-2 vs NYG after 5-35-3 prior miss.
items.why: McVay: Nacua not making great progress; Adams dominates solo.
items.implication: Adams elite WR1 play if Nacua out again vs DEN.
items.opportunity: 42% target rate, high aDOT/routes in Nacua absences.

items.text: Zay Flowers first hurt hamstring Aug 20 joint practice; aggravated after 5-150-1 Week 1 half, no full practice since; Brazil travel Week 3.
items.implication: Unlikely Week 3 vs DAL in Brazil; Ravens WR depth tested.
items.opportunity: Increased looks for other Ravens receivers.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor run D; high prop.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches, 15% tgt share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most RB rush yds.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit tgts both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA: SEA fewest FPs to WRs, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total (17).
